column1: # Which questions earn a visual card, and — the more important half — which must not.
# A card is derived from the typed ExecutionResult, never from the query text. That is what keeps
# the card and the prose in agreement: a card can only show what the answer already asserted, and
# if the engine defers there is no card at all. A wrong card is worse than no card, so every
# positive row here has a matching negative somewhere.
# expect_card is authored now and enforced once the card layer lands.
